title: WipEout HD Fury
note: Proven in Gate 4 on the 2D/60-fps route. Every value below was either fitted from, or scored against, the game's own native-3D output (Gate 3 capture). Do not hand-edit without re-running tools/fit_stereo.py.

provenance.scene: Racebox > Speed Lap > Venom > Vineta K (forward) > FEISAR, stationary on the start line

constant_slots.index_space: rsx-vp-c0-c467 (original guest indices, not compacted host offsets)

camera_position.role: camera world position; global per frame

camera_blocks.role: view-projection, perspective; c[256..259] is an affine world matrix on this route

constant_slots.matrix_convention: row-vector: clip = v.x*c[b] + v.y*c[b+1] + v.z*c[b+2] + c[b+3]; column 0 -> clip.x, column 3 -> clip.w

camera_position_policy.policy: per_eye on EVERY draw that reads it, independent of the matrix classifier
camera_position_policy.native_evidence: differs between eyes on 682 of 699 paired draws across 40 programs, always the same single left/right value pair - it is per-eye global camera state, not per-object data
camera_position_policy.why_separate_from_matrix: the 512x256 cascade passes read c[465] and the game DOES change it per eye there, but leaves their matrices identical. So the matrix shear and the camera-position update have different draw sets. The probe applies only the matrix shear; Gate 5 must apply both.
camera_position_policy.status: policy measured from the oracle; not yet applied by the probe

keying_rules: Never key on render-target addresses: the world pass was 0xc0f50000 in 2D but 0xc1680000 in native 3D.
Never key on shader hash alone: one screen-space program (8a3e5582d07b849) serves both post-process and the HUD.
Key on what the draw carries: render-target aspect and whether its camera block is perspective.

per_eye_if_all: render target aspect equals output aspect (within 2%)
program carries a PERSPECTIVE camera block: column 3 != (0,0,0,1); pick c[256..259] if perspective, else c[260..263]
draw_classification.why_both_rules: the perspective test alone excludes the HUD (orthographic) but not the five 512x256 cascade passes, whose c[260..263] is perspective yet shared between eyes; the aspect test excludes those 58 draws

stereo.transform_route: clip-space shear on the selected camera block: clip.x += sep * (clip.w - conv). Implemented as col0 += sep*col3, then c[b+3].x -= sep*conv. Independent of any world matrix folded into the block.

native_parameters.mono_camera: the 2D camera is the midpoint of the two native eyes (|2D - mid| = 0.046 of a 0.240 baseline)

hazards_for_gate5: RPCS3 refills transform constants only on guest constant writes, vertex-program ucode change, or interpreter/recompiler swap - NOT on a render-target change. The probe classifies at fill time. In this scene 0 of 827 draws inherit a stale classification, but the Gate 5 renderer must classify per draw, not per fill.
The 640x360 pass and infinity layers use different sep/conv. Gate 5 should either reproduce the four variants or derive them per draw.

Rotation probes pivot on c[465] in world space; on the two-matrix route the space between the world matrix and c[260..263] may be camera-relative. Stereo does not need rotations; the clip-space shear has no pivot.
